Marisol (docs): heads up — found a couple of inconsistencies in the metering + pricing docs while prepping the migration guide. screenshots show old slab display (floored), but backend now formats slab display as rounded. also the JS SDK snippet uses the old header name. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4587
Ilya (eng): good catch. backend change was intentional (round for UI), no change to stored quota math. impact is visual only.
Sam (pricing): confirm — billing calculations unchanged. must call out in docs so customers don't worry about charges. suggest sentence: "Display rounding changed to improve readability; underlying quota computation is unchanged."
Marisol (docs): thanks. I'm thinking we should: (1) swap screenshots, (2) add a short "what changed" note, (3) update both JS and curl snippets to include X-Redwood-Account header, and (4) adjust pricing calculator example explanation.
Jun (devexp): I'll provide a new JS snippet. Current snippet: ```js
const resp = await client.get('/usage', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` } });
``` New: ```js
const resp = await client.get('/usage', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Account': 'acct_abc' } });
// if resp.tier_key === 'legacy' treat as 'free' for UI mapping
``` Also add a curl example: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Account: acct_abc" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
Ilya (eng): I'll regenerate the dashboard images. command: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering` pushed to branch `docs/4587-metering-visuals`. note: export tool now includes PNG metadata that our image linter flags; will strip metadata in the export step.
Marisol (docs): nice. Jun — can you also change the pricing calculator example paragraph to say "calculator uses slab boundaries; displayed slab numbers may round for readability"? keeps things clear.
Sam (pricing): yes. also requesting a short FAQ blurb: "Why did my dashboard number change?" -> explain display rounding and confirm no billing impact.
l10n-bot: Locale check queued for `docs/pricing/calculator.md` and `docs/usage/metering.md` (en -> es, fr, de). ETA 36h.
Marisol (docs): I'll update the PR with new snippets, screenshot replacements, FAQ blurb, and a short migration note for customers on older SDKs. Also fixed two tiny heading levels caught by lint.
Ilya (eng): pushed images and updated panel reference in example queries. CI had a flaky test on the export script; reran and green now.
Jun (devexp): added the JS + curl snippets to the PR and included a one-liner about legacy `tier_key` mapping.
Sam (pricing): LGTM on wording. small ask: include a single sentence in PR description: "Visual-only change; no changes to billing or quotas."
Marisol (docs): will add that. action items: Marisol write PR blurb + swap screenshots, Ilya confirm export command in PR, Jun update SDK snippets, Sam add FAQ line, l10n-bot will run after merge. will request reviews when ready. :shipit:
